caption: The drawing depicts a single circular, hollow object with an elliptical central opening, resembling a ring or a torus, and features a short, narrow cylindrical neck at the top, suggestive of a vessel mouth. The object is predominantly rendered in shades of brown, with irregular splotches and patches of green distributed unevenly across the surface, giving a mottled appearance. The vessel sits centered within a lightly sketched rectangular border that frames the composition, and the background is a plain off-white or beige, with no additional objects or features present. The overall lines and coloring appear to be done in watercolor or ink, with visible shading to suggest volume and curvature.
title: Ring Bottle
